# Recovered P15.6 packet print source

`packet_print_job.pdf` was recovered read-only from the connected phone's
`/sdcard/Download/p15-5-experiment-packets-p034-2982-p036-1ce4-v1.pdf` during P15.7.
The user identified the Downloads packet file as the print source and reported
using **fit to page**. PDF text identifies the three pages as P034-2982,
P035-A333, and P036-1CE4, matching the physical photographs and phone packet
repository recovered in P15.6.

SHA-256: `3fb53d05a73ff8d17f23b03bccdebbe562405d0c8272a5f53fa54839448b39f4`.

This is the exported packet document, not a printer spool capture. Printer
model, driver, output media dimensions, selected margins, and physical output
measurements remain unavailable. The exact published semantic/layout artifact,
base PDF, image hashes, and unchanged answer keys remain in `../p15_6/`.

PDFium raster measurements and source-image landmarks are recorded in
`docs/development/evidence/p15_7/`, with provenance and uncertainty. They are
diagnostic evidence; they never supply per-bubble production corrections.
